title: Places: The Infinite Palace
template:
High atop a mountain of [color] mist sits the Great Castle. Legend says it has a thousand rooms, each filled with wonders. The front gate is guarded by a friendly creature who offers a magic key to every visitor.

As you walk through the winding halls, you find a room where the floors are made of [material]. In another room, the ceiling looks exactly like a starry night sky. You can hear a soft melody coming from a golden [object] sitting in the corner. Every hallway smells like fresh flowers or sweet vanilla.

At the very top of the tallest spire, there is a balcony overlooking the [nature_place]. This is where a gentle [animal] comes to rest and dream of new journeys. The castle of a thousand rooms is truly a place of eternal peace.
